uq_user_phone_active.name: uq_user_phone_active
uq_user_phone_active.where: "app_user"."deleted_at" IS NULL AND "app_user"."phone" IS NOT NULL

ix_outbox_stale_claims.name: ix_outbox_stale_claims
ix_outbox_stale_claims.where: "outbox_event"."published_at" IS NULL AND "outbox_event"."claimed_at" IS NOT NULL

ck_idempotency_completed_has_response.name: ck_idempotency_completed_has_response
ck_idempotency_completed_has_response.value: ("idempotency_key"."status" = 'completed') = ("idempotency_key"."response_status" is not null and "idempotency_key"."completed_at" is not null)

ck_address_required_not_blank.name: ck_address_required_not_blank
ck_address_required_not_blank.value:
length(btrim("address"."label")) > 0
          AND length(btrim("address"."recipient_name")) > 0
          AND length(btrim("address"."phone")) > 0
          AND length(btrim("address"."line1")) > 0
          AND length(btrim("address"."city")) > 0
          AND length(btrim("address"."state")) > 0
          AND length(btrim("address"."postal_code")) > 0

ck_promotion_shape.name: ck_promotion_shape
ck_promotion_shape.value:
(
        "promotion"."discount_type" = 'percentage'
          AND "promotion"."percent_rate" IS NOT NULL
          AND "promotion"."amount" IS NULL
      ) OR (
        "promotion"."discount_type" = 'fixed_amount'
          AND "promotion"."amount" IS NOT NULL
          AND "promotion"."percent_rate" IS NULL
      )

ck_promotion_window.name: ck_promotion_window
ck_promotion_window.value: "promotion"."starts_at" IS NULL OR "promotion"."ends_at" IS NULL OR "promotion"."ends_at" > "promotion"."starts_at"

ck_order_promotion_snapshot.name: ck_order_promotion_snapshot
ck_order_promotion_snapshot.value:
("order"."promotion_id" IS NULL AND "order"."promotion_code" IS NULL AND "order"."promotion_name" IS NULL)
          OR ("order"."promotion_id" IS NOT NULL AND "order"."promotion_code" IS NOT NULL AND "order"."promotion_name" IS NOT NULL)

ck_payment_provider_matches_method.name: ck_payment_provider_matches_method
ck_payment_provider_matches_method.value:
("payment"."method" = 'online' AND "payment"."provider" IS NOT NULL)
          OR ("payment"."method" = 'cod' AND "payment"."provider" IS NULL AND "payment"."provider_ref" IS NULL)
